messages.subject: Open data in Deducer
parts:
I have downloaded Deducer in R 2.11.1 on a computer with Windows XP
and on a computer Windows Vista.
However I cannot open data with Deducer in the computer with Windows
Vista. When I try "Open data" from the menu, it took me to where the
txt data is but I cannot open it.
Any hint why is that?
Best,

Manuel Spínola

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Open data in Deducer
parts:
Manuel,

So I'm gathering from your message that you are able to navigate to a file ending in '.txt' with the open data dialog, but nothing happens after you select it. Is that correct?

After opening a .txt file you should see another dialog titles 'Read Delimited File'. Are you using the JGR console, or the RGui console? Please enter the following into R after Deducer is loaded and send the output:

sessionInfo()
.jcall("java/lang/System","S","getProperty","java.version")

Best,
Ian
